candidate.original_question: What procedure or remedy is described in the clause beginning “CHAPTER IV CONSUMER DISPUTES REDRESSAL COMMISSION Establishment 28.”?
candidate.original_answer:
CHAPTER IV

                                 CONSUMER DISPUTES REDRESSAL COMMISSION

Establishment        28.
candidate.proposed_question: What does Section 28(1) require the State Government to establish?
candidate.proposed_answer: The State Government shall, by notification, establish a District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission in each district of the State; it may establish more than one in a district.
candidate.source_text_finding: Section 28(1) says the State Government shall establish a District Commission in each district by notification and may establish more than one in a district.
candidate.quality_or_scope_flags: Proposed answer includes the main direction and proviso. It is a close paraphrase of the supplied Act text.
candidate.source_provision_excerpt:
CHAPTER IV
CONSUMER DISPUTES REDRESSAL COMMISSION
28. (1) The State Government shall, by notification, establish a District Consumer
Disputes Redressal Commission, to be known as the District Commission, in each district of
the State:
Provided that the State Government may, if it deems fit, establish more than one
District Commission in a district.
